column1: # Triaged configspace findings (see known.go). Columns, tab separated:
# Only HARDENING, DEFECT and EXPECTED-DIFFERENCE rows are listed; configuration findings
# of a more serious class are triaged privately and stay novel in every run. A row is
# removed when TestKnownFindingsReproduce reports that it no longer reproduces.
# Triage: 2026-11-12, at the merge of origin/main 78de06b4b.
